examples.en: What do you take me for, Zhao Juemin? I just go to bed with whoever you say?
examples.zh: 你把我当什么呢，赵觉民！想让我跟谁睡，我就跟谁睡？

examples.en: Headquarters has approved my application. You're now the sales manager of our branch, succeeding Zhao Juemin.
examples.zh: 集团总公司已经批准了我的申请，任命你为咱们分公司销售部经理，在赵觉民之后。

tags: 弘强公司领导，意图贪钱不成，威胁余欢水
